evidence.description: 7 Design Principles distilled from all knowledge base materials + claw-code source

principles.name: Engineered ReAct Control Loop
principles.key_evidence: AssistantEvent enum, auto-compaction trigger, pre/post hook chain, usage tracking integrated per turn
principles.flaghunter_status: partial — has basic loop but no event model, no hooks, no auto compact

principles.name: Unified Tool Contract
principles.key_evidence: required_permission field on ToolSpec, single dispatch entry point, dynamic permission classification
principles.flaghunter_status: partial — has Tool registry but no permission field, dual execution paths

principles.name: Permission as Hard Gate
principles.key_evidence: Ordered PermissionMode (ReadOnly < WorkspaceWrite < DangerFullAccess), check_bash() with readonly whitelist, check_file_write() with workspace boundary

principles.name: Subagent as First-Class Citizen
principles.key_evidence: Independent ConversationRuntime per subagent, type-based tool allowlists (Explore/Plan/Verification/General), manifest file persistence, background thread execution
principles.flaghunter_status: missing — no Agent tool, no subagent runtime

principles.name: Externalized Memory Artifact System
principles.source: Official CLI docs + CLAUDE.md system + Hello-Agents memory model
principles.key_evidence: CLAUDE.md (project memory), skills/plugins (behavioral memory), todo/task state (episodic memory), compact summaries (procedural memory), session state (working memory)
principles.flaghunter_status: partial — has notes + ConversationMemory summary, no CLAUDE.md or session persistence

principles.name: GSSC Context Assembly Pipeline
principles.source: Hello-Agents (BB-326) + Claude Code system prompt structure
principles.key_evidence: Gather→Select→Structure→Compress pipeline, auto-compaction at 100K token threshold, per-turn reassembly
principles.flaghunter_status: partial — has RAG + notes injection but lacks unified pipeline

principles.name: Evolvable Capability Ecosystem
principles.source: Official plugin marketplace + MCP protocol + skills/commands/agents/hooks
principles.key_evidence: Plugin marketplace, layered capability exposure, MCP as protocol extension mechanism
principles.flaghunter_status: partial — has MCP server exposure, no MCP client bridge or plugin system

findings.detail: Basic ReAct loop exists; missing event model, hooks, auto compact
Tool registry exists; missing permission field, dual execution paths
No PermissionEnforcer, no permission modes, bash/terminal unrestricted
No Agent tool, no subagent runtime, no task decomposition ability
Has notes + summarization; missing CLAUDE.md, session persistence
Has scattered components; missing unified assembly pipeline
Has MCP server exposure; missing MCP client bridge, plugin system

phases.name: Establish Control Surface
phases.verification: ReadOnly blocks writes, WorkspaceWrite blocks external paths, readonly bash whitelist works

phases.name: Build Intelligence
phases.verification: Agent can spawn Explore subagent, subagent respects tool allowlist, ToolSearch returns relevant tools
key_decisions: Subagent reuses parent LLM instance with independent ConversationMemory
LLM autonomously decides when to spawn subagent (Agent tool in tool list)

phases.name: Enable Long-Running Capability
phases.verification: Tasks trackable, sessions resumable, CLAUDE.md injected

phases.name: Build Evolvable Ecosystem
phases.verification: External MCP tools consumable, hooks fire on tool use, turn-level traces visible

evidence.description: The fundamental shift from executor to decision-maker
evidence.current_model: plan-driven executor: user_task → force_plan → execute_steps → mark_done → exit
evidence.target_model: goal-driven decision-maker: user_goal → understand → decide(explore|plan|verify|search|execute) → self-verify → exit
enablers: Permission gate allows autonomous action within safety bounds
